title: Pays one today, floor on one, refuses one
script: Confirms the name and gives both security answers correctly. Can pay only the car loan today, in full. For the credit card, says the full amount is too much, then accepts the agent's next offer. Flatly refuses every offer for the personal loan without giving a reason. Confirms at the read-back.
